notes.title: Firefighters 2014 - Update 1.1
notes.content:
New update to Firefighters 2014 has been released. 
The update will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted. 

Patch Notes:

- optimized in terms of RAM usage and compatibility with 32-bit operating systems.

- Previously, the final station in the tutorial was omitted by mistake.
  The tutorial will now end properly with an explanation of the water filling station.

- The fences in the industrial area no longer occlude. Occlusion baking has been redone.

- The large tanks on the sidewalk in the industrial area now have collision detection.

- The material of the mounts of turntable ladder's indicators was set incorrectly. This error has been fixed.

- Minimap rotation is now enabled by default.

- Vehicle indicators can now be activated using the left and right mouse buttons.

- Fire station map: The smoke alarm at the farm was misaligned and was floating in the air. This error has been fixed.

- Fences' collision values has been increased so it is no longer possible to climb into the enclosure.

- The liter counter on refilling pumps now moves faster, making the number of liters pumped more credible.

- Fire extinguishers contain more.

- The water filling station has a larger radius in which the vehicle must be located to refill the tank.

- There are no longer any footstep sounds when the player stands still in the tutorial.

- Bugfix when using wrench/oil can/jumper cables. 

- The tool now only repairs a car if you also use it on the hood of the vehicle. 

- There is no longer a blocking radius at the site of randomly generated missions so that every operation location can really be reached from anywhere.(This is still present in bigger missions.)

- Some oil spills that were positioned too deep in the street have now been raised so that they no longer disappear.
